title: ICD-10 clinical registry & Australian Modification (AM) edition rules

test_cases.name: ICD-10 AM edition registry loaded
test_cases.input_setup: Initialize ICD10Registry singleton and check loaded code count
test_cases.expected_result: Registry loaded successfully with > 5,000 active codes
test_cases.evidence: ICD-10 Australian Modification registry loaded: 16953 codes available

test_cases.name: Diagnosis prompt registry linkage
test_cases.input_setup: Generate diagnosis prompt with candidate codes
test_cases.expected_result: Prompt references ICD-10 guidelines and injects candidate code catalogue
test_cases.evidence: Diagnosis prompt provides candidate codes from the verified registry

test_cases.name: ICD-10 code exact lookup
test_cases.expected_result: Returns exact verified medical description ('Pneumonia, unspecified')

test_cases.name: Invalid code rejection
test_cases.expected_result: Returns None; flagged as uncatalogued code
test_cases.evidence: Non-existent code ZZ99.99 correctly returned None (not found)

test_cases.name: Clinical symptom candidate search
test_cases.expected_result: Returns relevant ICD-10 candidates (e.g. R07 pain in throat/chest)
test_cases.evidence: Search for 'chest pain' returned 10 relevant candidates: [('R07.1', 'Chest pain on breathing'), ('R07.3', 'Other chest pain')]
